## Done — all requirements implemented under the staged change

### Files changed
- **`src/App.jsx`** — the full booking app (controls + logic + confirmation/edit + persistence).
- **`index.html`** — added a responsive `<style>` block (root div, script, and viewport meta preserved). Copied to `dist/` by the untouched `build.mjs`.

### Files intentionally untouched
`build.mjs`, `server.mjs` (fixtures intact: 409 sold-out `2030-06-15T19:00`, 503 error `2030-06-16T18:00`), `package.json`.

### How each requirement is met
- **Controls**: date (`type=date`), time `<select>` (17:00/18:00/19:00/20:00, now enabled), guests as a numeric input so out-of-range values *can* be entered and then rejected. Form has `noValidate` so my JS validation (not a native browser bubble) always runs and surfaces in the `message` element.
- **Max 8 / reject 9**: submit validates `1 ≤ integer ≤ 8`; `9` → visible error, no POST, no confirmation.
- **Large-party rule (7–8 ⇒ ≥18:00)**: `timeAllowedForGuests` blocks only 17:00. Enforced in three places — when guests change (clears the now-invalid time **and shows the reason**, per the requirement), when a time is picked, and defensively at submit. Times use zero-padded `HH:MM` so string compare == chronological.
- **Fixtures / helpful errors**: real `POST /api/reservations`; non-OK responses show the server's `error` text (sold-out / unavailable); network failure shows a fallback message. Form and inputs persist so the user can retry.
- **Confirmation**: success shows `data-testid="confirmation"` with date/time/guests and an `data-testid="edit"` button.
- **Edit + persistence**: booking saved to `localStorage`; Edit returns to the pre-filled form; re-submit overwrites storage. On load, state initializes from storage, so **refresh shows the saved (or edited) values**.
- **Layout 390/1440px**: centered column, `max-width:30rem`, `box-sizing:border-box`, full-width inputs — fits 390px without clipping and stays usable (not stretched) at 1440px; light/dark aware.
- **data-testid contract**: `date, time, guests, submit, message` (form view) and `confirmation, edit` (confirmation view) — all present.

### Limitations / not verified
- **I did not run any build.** The local `node build.mjs` verification needs a shell approval I was instructed not to request, so I did not run it and I am **not** claiming any build (local or external) was executed. The source is plain React/JSX that esbuild (`jsx:'automatic'`) compiles with the React/react-dom already present at the app root. The external harness runs `node build.mjs` and browser acceptance.
- **Browser acceptance not run by me** — scenarios above were verified by tracing code against the server fixture, not by executing a browser.
